name: elastic-line
title: Elastic Line
description: A hairline drawn across a dark page that can be caught by the pointer. Moving near it drags the middle into a stretch, and letting go springs it back to a straight line.
use: A sparse editorial page wants one playful interactive detail that rewards moving the cursor across it.
avoid: It is a mouse-and-touch flourish with no keyboard path and needs a wide, tall area to be worth pulling.
a11y: A pointer-only flourish with no keyboard equivalent, and the spring always animates because prefers-reduced-motion is not checked. (keyboard: no, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a black stage a single hairline runs horizontally across the full width, over dark demo copy. At rest it is perfectly straight and very thin; when pulled it bows into a smooth curve, up to a tall pointed arch, before settling flat again.
behaves: The line draws itself in from left to right on first load. When the pointer comes within a few pixels it grabs the midpoint and stretches it toward the cursor; moving past the release threshold or leaving the area springs it back with a light wobble.
customise: Vertical or horizontal, grab and release thresholds, stroke width and spring transitions are props; the line colour follows currentColor and the page supplies its own content.
weight: light: One SVG path updated each frame while grabbed; otherwise a spring.
demo: Heading 'STASH UI', an orange asterisk, and 'Grab the line and pull. Ready-to-use animated React components...'.
issues: The hairline is so thin and dim that it nearly disappears at rest.
When it bows, the line crosses the paragraph and makes the text harder to read.
polishWhy: Subtle, satisfying elastic interaction; the hairline is very faint at rest.
